notes.title: 25.03.26 Update(JP translation fix / death count / level 3-5 one shot deny)
notes.content:
Hello, this is Sinpodo, the developer of Teleport Master!
This time, we have added 3 updates.

1. Improved Japanese consistency
Some of the Japanese translations that were improved this time have had some incorrect or awkward expressions improved.

2. Added Death Count
When clearing a game, the number of times you die will be displayed along with the play time!

3. Removed one-time clear for levels 3, 4, and 5
The existing levels 3, 4, and 5 can be cleared if you can go through them exactly in one go.
However, we found out that this was intended as a shortcut and reduced the sense of challenge. Therefore, we modified it so that it cannot be cleared even if you go through them in one go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359838/1f8e23c51e18074df6355ab1f329c2025d6069a1.png[/img]
I hope this update will also add elements that make the game more fun. Thank you for checking the article!

notes.title: Combo System Update + Improved Japanese Traslation
notes.content:
Hello, Teleport Masters.
I am so happy that you purchased Teleport Master.
This time, I received a lot of feedback through reviews and there were some things that I greatly sympathized with.
Based on this, I made two major updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359838/684490696ed529c9d70b1c16ee4104eaf1ce3ba3.gif[/img]
One is the combo system! If you teleport consecutively, the screen will go crazy!
If you teleport 3 times in a row, this system will be activated, and if you teleport 10 times or more, certain obstacles on the stage will pop up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359838/87214f1b141d87d17ab501cce3cd8514c549e78c.jpg[/img]
Of course, you can turn it off in the options, so if it bothers you, turn it off!

The second is the improvement of the Japanese translation. This time, I saw a review that the Japanese translation was awkward. In fact, the translation was very awkward due to my lack of Japanese interpretation skills. Luckily, I was able to improve the Japanese translation with the help of 'Place_b'. 
Also, at Place_b's recommendation, I changed the font to make it easier to read Japanese. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359838/c04ff9fdf141a2e61e35c772a764a4de80018224.jpg[/img]
Many people are playing in Japanese. I hope that these users will feel more comfortable checking the story through this update. 

Thank you all for teleporting!

notes.title: Ending Point Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359838/7caedfb872ef7a5295d75b5f6cf014e01f195a2b.png[/img]

Hello, I am SinPoDo, a Teleport master developer.
I am having a happy life as a game developer because many people enjoy my games.
Meanwhile, we received feedback that people were confused by the fact that they could see the ending just by pressing forward.
It was an attempt to create a game where anyone could see the ending.
However, it didn't seem to work out as intended, so a clear goal point was added.
So the difficulty level may have increased a bit!
Still, I hope you enjoy it as it gets a little closer to the intention of the main story.
Thank you for reading the article.

(Original Text)
안녕하세요 저는 Teleport master 개발자 SinPoDo입니다.
제 게임을 많은 분들이 즐겨주셔서 행복한 게임개발인생을 보내고 있습니다.
그러던 도중 앞으로 누르기만 해도 엔딩이 봐진다는 것에 혼란을 느낀다는 피드백을 받았습니다.
누구나 엔딩을 볼 수 있는 게임을 만들고 싶어서 한 시도였습니다.
다만, 의도대로 잘 되지 않은 것 같아 확실한 골인 지점을 추가했습니다.
그래서 난이도가 조금 올라갔을 겁니다!
그래도 본편의 의도에 조금 더 가까워진 만큼 즐겁게 해주셨으면 좋겠습니다.
글 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.
